# eval-harness

> A drop-in harness for evaluating AI systems on your own data: freeze a dataset, run a system against it, and decide
> with paired tests whether one system is better than another or only ahead on this sample. The package is in
> `harness/`; this repository also holds worked evals (`examples/`, `research/`), the docs (`docs/`) and the deployment
> of evals.humancopilot.eu (`infra/`).

This file is the agent-facing index of the docs (llmstxt.org). It is generated by `tools/llms_txt.py` from this
template (`tools/llms.in.txt`) and the docs' own titles and status lines; `make llms` writes it and `make llms-check`
fails when it is stale or a link does not resolve. `AGENTS.md` holds the rules for coding agents. Decisions are ADRs,
designs with their alternatives are RFCs, what users need is in PRDs and what they see in UXS; each set has an index
that lists every document with its status.

## Agent rules

- [AGENTS.md: Observability: dev and prod](AGENTS.md#observability-dev-and-prod): the rules for this area, read before changing it

- [eval-harness](README.md): what the harness is, the worked evals, how to try it

## Decisions and specs

- [ADRs](docs/adr/index.md): the decisions that shape the architecture; 19 documents, each with its status (16 built, 3 accepted)
- [RFCs](docs/rfc/index.md): the technical designs, with their alternatives; 26 documents, each with its status (22 built, 3 draft, 1 superseded)
- [PRDs](docs/prd/index.md): what users need, and why; 11 documents, each with its status (11 built)
- [UXS](docs/uxs/index.md): what users see and type; 5 documents, each with its status (5 active)

The decisions every change must respect:

- [ADR-0029 — One data model; the command line, the API and MCP made from one registry](docs/adr/ADR-0029-one-model-two-surfaces.md): one model; the command line, the API, MCP and OpenAPI are made from one registry of operations (status: Accepted (owner, 2026-11-13, RFC-032))
- [ADR-0030 — Per-item results as tables in the SQLite store; the files store stays JSONL](docs/adr/ADR-0030-per-item-results-as-tables.md): per-item results: tables in the SQLite store, JSONL in the files store (status: Accepted (owner, 2026-11-15, RFC-033))
- [ADR-0024 — Several projects run on one machine, and share nothing](docs/adr/ADR-0024-several-projects-on-one-machine.md): several projects on one machine: each its own stable port, each named where two could be confused (status: Accepted (owner, 2026-11-01), with RFC-023)
- [ADR-0021 — A deployment, not a model, is what is vetted and fingerprinted](docs/adr/ADR-0021-a-deployment-is-vetted.md): what is fingerprinted and vetted is a deployment, not a model (status: Accepted (owner, 2026-10-31), built in 0.6.0)
- [ADR-0026 — A contender is shown no worse than the leader; a strategy is a default margin](docs/adr/ADR-0026-contenders-by-non-inferiority.md): how a goal decides: contenders shown no worse than the leader (status: Accepted (owner, 2026-11-05))

- [RFC-026: An API for every command, long ones as jobs](docs/rfc/RFC-026-an-api-for-every-command.md): the API and its jobs, as first designed (status: Partly superseded by RFC-032 and ADR-0029: the registry made from the commands' parsers...)
- [UXS-003: The command line and the first evaluation](docs/uxs/UXS-003-cli-and-onboarding.md): the command line as people use it (status: Active)
- **Stores, run records and formats** (`harness/scripts/_store.py`, `harness/scripts/_outputs.py`, `harness/scripts/_runs.py`, `harness/scripts/migrations/`):
- [RFC-025: A project's data in SQLite, a project's choice](docs/rfc/RFC-025-runs-in-sqlite.md): the SQLite store, a project's choice (status: Accepted (2026-11-06), minimal version first (owner))
- [RFC-033: Per-item results as a model, in both stores](docs/rfc/RFC-033-per-item-results-as-a-model.md): per-item results as a model, in both stores (its "As built") (status: Accepted and built (0.8.0): steps a and b d853c6550, their end-to-end proofs 325a04f5a,...)
- [RFC-024: A run's outputs in one file, read through one function](docs/rfc/RFC-024-run-outputs-in-one-file.md): a run's outputs, read through one function (status: Accepted and built for 0.8.0 (2026-11-05, the owner's go to build it))
- [RFC-002: Run records and derived runs](docs/rfc/RFC-002-run-records-and-derived-runs.md): run records and derived runs (status: Completed (v0.4.0))
- [Upgrading](harness/docs/UPGRADING.md): each format, and the migration that reaches it
- **Running a system, fingerprints, providers** (`harness/scripts/run.py`, `harness/scripts/_fingerprint.py`, `harness/scripts/adapter.py`):
- [RFC-021: Fingerprint v5: the deployment, the settings, and the runner](docs/rfc/RFC-021-fingerprint-v5.md): the fingerprint: the deployment, the settings, the runner (status: Built for 0.6.0 (2026-10-31), from its first draft, on the owner's go of 2026-10-31 ("l...)

- [ADR-0005 — One provider layer; credentials per role, never identity](docs/adr/ADR-0005-credentials-per-role.md): one provider layer, credentials per role (status: Accepted (2026-10-25), as built)

- [Evaluation protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md): the evaluation protocol
- [PRD-001: Running evals and comparing arms](docs/prd/PRD-001-evals-and-comparison.md): what comparing arms must give (status: Implemented (v0.4.0))

- [ADR-0028 — From 10,000 items a paired test's p is its normal limit, not resampled](docs/adr/ADR-0028-large-samples-use-the-normal-limit.md): large samples (status: Accepted (2026-11-08))

## By service

What triage needs for each service that reports errors or logs to the homelab's observability.

- **evals-inspector** (the catalog's API; `harness/scripts/catalog_serve.py` with `infra/inspector/hooks.py`): GlitchTip
  `evals-inspector` (37), service `evals-inspector` in VictoriaLogs (`app:evals`) and VictoriaTraces.
  [infra/README.md: the containers](infra/README.md#the-containers),
  [RFC-003](docs/rfc/RFC-003-catalog-adapter.md).
- **evals-mcp** (the MCP server; `harness/scripts/mcp_server.py` with `infra/mcp/hooks.py`): GlitchTip `evals-mcp`
  (38), service `evals-mcp` in VictoriaLogs and VictoriaTraces, a Umami event per call.
  [infra/README.md: the containers](infra/README.md#the-containers),
  [RFC-018](docs/rfc/RFC-018-read-only-mcp-server.md).
- **evals-web** (nginx: the site and the built catalog; `infra/nginx/`): GlitchTip `evals-web` (36, the CSP reports),
  service `evals-web` in VictoriaLogs. [infra/README.md: the containers](infra/README.md#the-containers).
- **evals-dev** (dev runs of both servers, `make serve-dev` and `make mcp-dev`): GlitchTip `evals-dev` (40), every
  signal labelled `environment=dev` and `worktree`, read with the `o11y-dev` skill.
  [infra/README.md: dev observability](infra/README.md#dev-observability-on-a-workstation),
  [AGENTS.md: observability](AGENTS.md#observability-dev-and-prod).
